items.title: How does a blocking task reach the captain from home?
items.context: Gear/merch checks, document problems and low wallet all stop a captain going online. The files show four different ways to surface them, and Home Page 2026 (final) shows none of them. This is what Claude guessed wrong on Verify Merch.

options.label: Status card on home → full task page
options.detail: Card under the header (title, status, link, illustration with badge). Tap opens a full page like Verify Merch. Used in Logistics merch auth and New Onboarding doc nudge.

options.label: Action Centre list
options.detail: 'Take action now (n)' section with scrolling cards and View all. Exists only in Home Page 2026 kitchen.

options.label: Red banner under header
options.detail: Full-width red 'Orders will be blocked!' banner with Take Action. Home Page 2026, wallet only.

options.label: Bottom sheet when tapping Go On Duty
options.detail: Nothing on home; sheet appears on going online. Face Auth suspension and selfie nudge.

items.recommend: A, with D as the fallback when the captain taps Go On Duty without finishing

items.title: Trip steps: tap or swipe?
items.context: Arrived / Start ride / Complete ride. E-rickshaw's ✅ 'removing swipe from CTA' replaced swipe, but its ✅ Post activation page and Bundle Orders still use the slider.

options.label: Tap + confirm bottom sheet
options.detail: Full-width primary button, then a sheet: illustration, 'Are you sure…?', rule copy, confirm + secondary.

options.label: Swipe slider
options.detail: Keep the swipe-to-confirm button.

items.title: Results and confirmations: centred card or bottom sheet?
items.context: Activation success is a centred card (My Plans), plan outcomes are a bottom sheet, 'Please wait' is a centred card, blocked/failed is a sheet, success over home is a centred card with no button.

options.label: Split by purpose
options.detail: Centred card for progress and short success. Bottom sheet for anything the captain has to read or decide.

options.label: Always bottom sheet
options.detail: Every result and confirmation is a sheet.

options.label: Always centred card
options.detail: Every result is a centred modal card.

items.title: Picking one option from several
items.context: My Plans L1 uses cards each with 'View Details'. Bike SaaS, onboarding service choice and zone choice use radio cards with a sticky footer.

options.label: Radio cards + sticky confirm footer
options.detail: Select in place; footer shows the selection (and price) and one primary button, disabled until chosen.

options.label: Cards with View Details
options.detail: Each card opens its own detail page that holds the action.

options.label: Both, by rule
options.detail: A when options are simple; B when each option needs a full explanation (plans).

items.title: Primary button colour
items.context: Four primary styles in final pages: Runway yellow, dark navy pill (My Plans), green (plan intro), black/blue outline pills.

options.label: Yellow only
options.detail: Runway yellow is the only filled primary. Others become secondary/tertiary.

options.label: Yellow + themed exceptions
options.detail: Allow a themed primary inside branded surfaces (My Plans dark hero, plan intro).

items.title: Page header
items.context: Three headers are used for inner pages: Runway Internal Page Header, a different 'Internal page Header' from another library (camera, Assure, onboarding), and hand-built back/Help/call rows.

options.label: Runway only, add a dark variant
options.detail: Every inner page uses Runway Internal Page Header; add a dark variant for camera screens and a call action.

options.label: Allow local headers
options.detail: Keep per-flow headers.

items.title: Wrong document uploaded
items.context: The ✅ Doc classifier page shows both treatments for the same error.

options.label: Inline
options.detail: Red banner under the header, failed image with red border, 'Upload again' in place.

options.label: Bottom sheet
options.detail: Sheet with the image, red error box, Retake + opt-out.

items.recommend: A (the captain stays on the form)

items.title: One look for verification status
items.context: Status (to do / verifying / verified / failed) is drawn three ways: onboarding checklist cards, home nudge rows, Document Centre cards. Logistics has a fourth: the Verify Merch task row.

options.label: One Task row component
options.detail: Logistics task row (thumbnail, label, status caption, arrow/check) used everywhere.

options.label: One Checklist card
options.detail: Onboarding step card (icon tile, label, coloured status, trailing pill) used everywhere.

options.label: Keep separate
options.detail: Each flow keeps its own.

items.title: Close button on bottom sheets
items.context: Most final sheets put a round × floating above the sheet on the dim background. Check against Runway Bottom Sheet.

options.label: Floating above the sheet
options.detail: Round × on the scrim, top-right, above the sheet.

options.label: Inside the sheet
options.detail: × in the sheet's top row.

items.title: Order alert card: follow the OA framework?
items.context: Runway's OA cards are split by vehicle (Bike/Auto/Cab) with no themes. The OA framework (May '26) splits by order type with themes and a max of 2 signals.

options.label: Rebuild Runway card on the framework
options.detail: Base / sub-service / contextual / preference buckets, theme variants, tag row, 264 or 272 width fixed.

options.label: Keep Runway per-vehicle cards
options.detail: Leave Runway as is.

items.title: Snackbar after turning a setting off
items.context: Turning Go To Area off shows a red snackbar, the error colour, for a successful action.

options.label: Neutral/dark
options.detail: Success of any action is neutral or green; red only for failure.

options.label: Red
options.detail: Keep red for 'turned off'.

items.title: Error sheet title colour
items.context: Blocked/failed sheets use a red title in one place and a neutral title in another.

options.label: Neutral title
options.detail: Red lives only in the illustration badge.

options.label: Red title
options.detail: Title is red for every error.

items.title: Status labels
items.context: Statuses appear as coloured text, hand-made pills, or Runway Tag.

options.label: Runway Tag
options.detail: Every status label is a Tag (success/warning/error/neutral).

options.label: Coloured text
options.detail: Plain coloured text is allowed in rows.

items.recommend: A for standalone labels, coloured caption only inside Task rows

items.title: Bottom navigation
items.context: Final Home of Orders uses a local 'Bottom Nav Final': Home + Orders pill (grey / black-open / yellow-with-count). Runway's samples are Home/Credit/Earnings. Home 2026 uses another library.

options.label: Update Runway nav to the Orders-pill model
options.detail: Runway BottomNavigation gets the Orders pill and its three states; used everywhere.

options.label: Keep Runway as is
options.detail: No change.

items.title: Optional step label
items.context: Opt-out buttons say 'I do not have a license' / 'I Do Not Have A License' / 'Upload later'.

options.label: Sentence case
options.detail: All button labels in sentence case.

options.label: Title Case
options.detail: All button labels in Title Case.

items.title: Task checklist page
items.when: The captain must finish several independent checks (photos, documents) before something unlocks.
items.structure: Internal Page Header (back, title, Help) → hero image 360×202 → title Bold 24 → Task rows (gap 16) → sticky footer: Primary Large disabled until all done + helper text + tertiary link (e.g. 'Apply for merch →').
items.notes: Later frames drop the escape link; footer overlaps last row by 12px.

items.title: Document upload page
items.when: Collect a two-sided ID (DL, Aadhaar, RC) and its number.
items.structure: Header → info banner with audio → Front tile → Back tile (enabled after front) → number field with example → sticky footer: Submit + outline opt-out.
items.notes: Optional docs tag the photo section 'Not Compulsory'. OCR can prefill the number.

items.title: Camera capture → preview → verify
items.when: Live photo of a document, selfie or merch item.
items.structure: Dark header (back, item name) → full-bleed camera with optional frame → bottom panel: title, guidance, Gallery + shutter. Preview: Retake | Submit side by side, Rotate/Crop. Then centred status card: Verifying → Success / Failed + Retry.
items.notes: Selfie uses a circular viewfinder. Live-only (no gallery) for merch.

items.title: Programme hub with sticky action footer
items.when: Landing page of a programme (referral, plan detail): what you earned, what's on offer, one main action.
items.structure: Internal Page Header (Help) → hero banner → summary card (₹, chevron) → section title → offer rows → sticky footer (code + Copy, primary).
items.notes: Footer exists with and without Copy.

items.title: Tabbed tracker list with search
items.when: Track many people or items by status and act per row.
items.structure: Header → summary card → Primary Tabs → search field → rows (avatar, name, status, trailing small button or amount).

items.title: Contact picker with invite
items.when: Invite people from phone contacts.
items.structure: Header → search → rows (initials avatar, name, number, 'Invite' pill with WhatsApp/SMS icon).

items.title: Person detail with reminder panel
items.when: Nudge one referred person to their next step.
items.structure: Header → profile row with earnings → milestone timeline → tinted panel with message preview → primary 'Send Reminder' (WhatsApp/SMS).

items.title: Document Centre
items.when: Review all documents after onboarding.
items.structure: Header → pending cards (status, Upload Again) → 'Completed Documents' divider → completed rows.

items.title: Full-screen intro takeover
items.when: First exposure to a new plan or feature.
items.structure: Dark full screen → back → logo → highlighted card with audio → single CTA. Variant: dimmed page with close and a tall image/video card.

items.title: Time-bound offers page
items.when: Browse incentives with dates and status.
items.structure: Header + Secondary Tabs → date strip → audio guide → filter chips with counts → status cards (Live / Coming / Ended / Missed) → accordions.

items.title: Payment collection page
items.when: Confirm cash collected before closing an order.
items.structure: Header (Payments, Help) → payment details (amount, split, wallet) → your QR → OR → 'Collect Cash' → confirm sheet (Go back / Collected).

items.title: Wallet home and add UPI
items.when: Check balance, transfer, add a payment method.
items.structure: Header (Earnings, Help) → tabs → balance card → education carousel → history. Add UPI: upload QR photo OR type UPI ID → verify → added.

items.title: Explainer sheet before a task
items.when: Explain rules before a capture or multi-step task starts.
items.structure: Scrim + floating × → sheet: hero illustration → title Bold 24 → 2–3 bullet rules → red Note box for consequences → [consent checkbox] → full-width primary 'Start'.

items.title: Single-message sheet (blocked / rejected / info)
items.when: Tell the captain one thing that happened and give one action.
items.structure: Scrim + × → sheet: illustration with status badge → title (states the block and duration) → one reason line → primary 'OK'.
items.notes: Re-shown each time the captain tries to go online; no persistent sign on home.

items.title: Confirm sheet with consequence warning
items.when: An action has side effects (switch zone, complete ride).
items.structure: Sheet title as question → from → to chips → orange warning box → Primary 'Yes, …' + Secondary 'Go Back'.

items.title: 'Please wait' progress card
items.when: Upload or verification in progress; block the page briefly.
items.structure: Dimmed page → centred card: yellow ring spinner, bold 'Please Wait', one line naming the action.

items.title: Success card on dim background
items.when: Confirm something took effect.
items.structure: Scrim (+ ×) → card with green check badge → bold subject + one line → [Okay].
items.notes: Home 2026 version has no way to dismiss.

items.title: Outcome sheet with tinted header
items.when: End of a plan window: tell the money outcome.
items.structure: Dimmed home → × → sheet with tinted top (green success / yellow warning / blue neutral) showing the card → title with amount → body → OK.

items.title: Not-eligible explanation
items.when: Captain taps an option they can't use.
items.structure: Dimmed list → × above card → lock icon, 'This plan is not for you', reason. No button.

items.title: Celebration card
items.when: Captain just earned a reward; push to the next milestone.
items.structure: Dimmed home → gradient card: 3D illustration, caption, big ₹, sentence → in-card primary.

items.title: Consent checkbox unlocks the button
items.when: Legal consent is required before continuing.
items.structure: Checkbox + legal text with inline link, directly above a full-width primary that stays disabled until ticked.

items.title: Coachmark with audio
items.when: Teach a new or low-literacy captain one control at a time.
items.structure: Dim with a cut-out around one element → tooltip (title, body, n/3, Skip, Next/Got it) → optional audio tile.

items.title: Floating help button (Saathi / Captain Assist)
items.when: Help is always one tap away on home, trip and payment screens.
items.structure: Pill bottom-right: collapsed (icon) / expanded (label) / playing; 'Tap to Play' animation on app open.
items.notes: Three local versions under three names.

items.title: Snackbar for settings saved to the server
items.when: Captain flips a setting that the server must confirm.
items.structure: Dark snackbar with spinner 'Turning on X' above the nav → green '✓ X is turned on' (2–3 s) or red error with ×.

items.title: Inline banners (info / note / important)
items.when: Explain why something is needed, or warn of a consequence, inside a page or sheet.
items.structure: Full-width tinted box: icon + 1–2 lines + optional circular audio button. Blue info, red note, orange warning.

items.title: Vendor verification hand-off
items.when: Face match by HyperVerge SDK.
items.structure: App explainer sheet → vendor screens (intro, permission, oval capture, result) → back to app result sheet. App owns only before/after.

items.title: Home that changes with duty state
items.when: The root screen.
items.structure: Header (menu, duty toggle, location, bell) → Today's Earnings bar → performance banner → [off duty: greeting + 'Go On Duty' | on duty: map card] → stories → 'Only for you' carousel → shortcuts → bottom nav.
items.notes: Three duty toggles in one file.

items.title: Map card with layer pills
items.when: On duty: show demand layers.
items.structure: 328×328 map card, right buttons (maximise, location, SOS), max 4 pills + ··· to expand; maximise = full-screen map. Zone card (airport/HAIL) attaches to pills.

items.title: Home modules
items.when: Content blocks on home.
items.structure: Performance banner (streak dots), stories row (ringed avatars), 'Only for you' offer carousel, shortcut tiles (3 across), header quick-peek wallet panel, header-dropped announcement.

items.title: Nudge card in the order list
items.when: Suggest one filter or service without blocking orders.
items.structure: Card at top of the order list: feature tint, ×, illustration, title, body, exactly one action (button or toggle rows). Success → green snackbar, card closes, pill turns on.

items.title: Programme entry points
items.when: Make a programme findable.
items.structure: Side-menu row (icon, title, 'Earn up to ₹X'), wallet banner, home tile, strip at top of Incentives.
items.notes: Testing found the banner was hard to notice.

items.title: Copilot chat
items.when: AI assistant from the home sparkle button.
items.structure: Chat page (back, title, EN/हिंदी) → greeting + suggestion chips → answer cards → sticky input with mic.

items.title: Order card themed by order type
items.when: Every incoming order alert.
items.structure: Service chip + fare (₹ Bold 32, green +extra) + icon slot → route (pickup/drop km + address) → optional tag row → optional tips → Reject timer ring + Accept.
items.notes: Max 2 signals. Company overrides. Themes: Priority dark+gold, Company blue, Intercity sky, GTA pink, Seat share teal.

items.title: Order list with side tabs
items.when: On duty with one or more order alerts.
items.structure: Header (count + voice toggle) → 64px tab rail (timer + fare per order) | stack of order cards → bottom nav with Orders pill.

items.title: Voice order alert
items.when: Voice mode on: the app reads the order aloud.
items.structure: Active card gets a green border; the field being read is highlighted; toggling voice shows a 3 s snackbar.

items.title: Accept again / Only for you
items.when: Order needs re-confirmation, or is exclusive to good performers.
items.structure: Dim → themed header strip (red 'Accept Again!' / green 'Only For You') → order card → countdown then Accept; Reject as separate pill.

items.title: Order alert over other screens
items.when: App in background or captain on a trip.
items.structure: One compact order card pinned at top over the current screen/map; tap opens the list; 'see more' only when >1; nav pill turns yellow with count.

items.title: Order tag row
items.when: Extra context that is not a theme (GTA distance, Main Road Pick Up, tips).
items.structure: Row inside the card between route and buttons: icon + short label chip.
items.notes: Three tag looks; Runway Tag not used.

items.title: Filter pill with attached panel
items.when: Set an order filter (Go To, Stay In, Services, Customers) without leaving orders.
items.structure: Pill row under the header → tapped pill becomes a tab with a tinted panel: helper text, toggle rows, footer text actions. Closes on tap outside or after 20 s.

items.title: No orders: search, refresh, check account
items.when: On duty and no orders.
items.structure: 'Searching for orders…' → Refresh after 4 s, then every 20 s → after a while 'or' + 'Not getting orders?' + 'Check Account Status' → status stepper page → result.
items.notes: Logistics variant suggests switching space instead.

items.title: Bundle order alert
items.when: Offer 2+ orders as one decision.
items.structure: Bundle header (₹130+, time, vehicle +2) → order 1 card → '+' → order 2 card (estimate only) → Reject ring + Accept.

items.title: Between bundle orders
items.when: Order 1 done; find or assign the next one.
items.structure: Dimmed home → card: 'Searching' with guarantee line → '2nd Order Assigned' + order card + 'Go to pickup' / not-found card with promised amount / 'Choose in 00:15' list of 2–3 orders.

items.title: End of order
items.when: Trip complete.
items.structure: Header → stamp → estimated earnings → km/min → split → one feedback question (chips or Yes/No) → sticky Done (or 'Go To 2nd Order' in a bundle).

items.title: Multistop route
items.when: Order with stops between pickup and drop.
items.structure: Route line with a black '2 Stops' pill between pickup and drop.
items.notes: Not in the OA framework yet.

items.title: Progress tracker card
items.when: Captain has an active goal (earnings, rides, time).
items.structure: Status tag + plan name + fee → '₹x/₹500' with bar → segmented rides bar '6/9 rides' → status line with icon.
items.notes: Blue on home, green on plan page.

items.title: Milestone timeline
items.when: Reward unlocks over steps.
items.structure: Status header (title, Tag, 'x/3 completed') → vertical steps: done (green number, time, +₹) / locked (grey lock, deadline) → dashed connector.

items.title: Onboarding status checklist
items.when: Show progress across onboarding steps.
items.structure: Banner coloured by overall state (blue pending / peach verifying / red failed) with 'N steps left' → step cards with status and trailing Upload / hourglass / Upload Again.

items.title: Earning-loss nudge inside a card
items.when: Show money missed and a switch-plan action on Earnings / order details.
items.structure: Light-blue panel inside Today's Earnings: logo, 2 lines ('You missed ₹100 today…'), pill button.
items.notes: Text overflows in 6 of 7 languages.

items.title: Numbers in copy are placeholders
items.detail: Durations, amounts and counts are always parameters, never typed in. Face Auth hard-codes '2 hours' in English while Hindi uses %1$d; Home of Orders and Referral show raw %1$d / ₹%1$d on screen.

items.title: Layouts survive long Indian-language text
items.detail: Pills, buttons and headers must allow 2 lines or shrink. Overflow up to 154px seen in Kannada, Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu (Bike Lift pill, duty toggle, referral button, nudge banners).

items.title: Fonts cover every Indian script
items.detail: Kannada OA card and Tamil/Malayalam/Telugu pages render blank text: the font has no glyphs.

items.title: Translations come from the current English page
items.detail: Most localisation pages are older copies: missing screens, ~30% text still English, Tamil page with Bengali text, 'Empty' in place of values. Regenerate after every English change.

items.title: One action per nudge
items.detail: From the Nudge Framework: a nudge card carries exactly one action. A multi-action card was rejected.

items.title: Nudges never block taking orders
items.detail: From the Nudge Framework, principle 4. Blocking needs belong in the blocking-task pattern (decision D01).

items.title: At most 2 signals on an order card
items.detail: From the OA framework. Company can override the rest. Sub-services get an icon, never a theme.

items.title: Same thing, same words
items.detail: One approved string per concept. Seen: 'Quick selfie / Selfie / face verification', '2nd Order Assigned / assigned / is accepted', 'Under verification... / Under Verification'.

items.title: Final pages use only Runway components
items.detail: Ready-for-dev frames still use Today's Earnings Accordion, CTA, Filter Pills, Slider Buttons, '.Buttons(Rejected)' and other non-Runway parts. Anything missing gets added to Runway first.

items.title: Audio help next to instructions
items.detail: Low-literacy support: an audio button sits beside any instruction banner, plan explainer or coachmark (used in Onboarding, My Plans, Logistics, E-rickshaw).

items.title: Every overlay can be dismissed
items.detail: Success and not-eligible cards with no button and no × were found. Every overlay needs a way out (× or a button).

items.title: Task row
items.detail: Thumbnail 44, label 16 medium, status caption 14 (Verified green #058743 / Failed! Retry red #c42925), trailing arrow or check. 328w, pad 12, gap 8, radius 12, 1px Border/Neutral/Light, shadow. Exact values from Logistics.

items.title: List row family
items.detail: One row with slots: leading (icon / avatar / thumbnail), title + caption, trailing (chevron / toggle / small button / amount / invite pill). Covers person, contact, offer, toggle and permission rows.

items.title: Inline alert
items.detail: Info (blue), note/error (red), warning (orange); icon, title, body, optional audio button.

items.title: Audio explainer button and bar
items.detail: Circular play/progress button; inline player with language switch.

items.title: Document upload tile
items.detail: Dashed tile: side label, sample illustration, Upload; uploaded state with image + Retake; error state with red border.

items.title: Camera screens
items.detail: Dark header, viewfinder with frame (card or circle), guidance panel, Gallery + shutter, preview with Retake/Submit, crop with Done.

items.title: Status card overlay
items.detail: Centred card on scrim: Please wait / Verifying (spinner), Success (check), Failed (! + Retry). Replaces Toast used as a modal.

items.title: Consent checkbox row
items.detail: Checkbox + multi-line legal text with inline link; drives the button's disabled state.

items.title: Sticky footer
items.detail: Bottom bar: optional selection summary (label, name, price), helper text, primary button, optional text link.

items.title: Selectable option card
items.detail: Large radio card: illustration, title, subtitle, radio, optional video/audio link, info strip; disabled state.

items.title: Coachmark
items.detail: Scrim with cut-out, tooltip with step count, Skip/Next, optional audio tile.

items.title: Help button (Saathi)
items.detail: Floating pill: collapsed, expanded, playing.

items.title: Nudge card
items.detail: Themed card with ×, illustration slot, title, body, one action.

items.title: Home status card
items.detail: Card on home: title, status line, link, illustration with status badge (pending / failed / success).

items.title: Filter pill with panel
items.detail: Pill states and attached tinted panel with toggle rows and footer actions.

items.title: Empty state
items.detail: Illustration/text, optional Refresh button (idle/spinning/done), optional 'or' + escalation action.

items.title: Stepper / timeline
items.detail: Vertical steps with done / current / locked / expired states, amounts and connector. Used for milestones, account check, Assure.

items.title: Progress tracker card
items.detail: Linear and segmented bars, status tag, status line.

items.title: Search field
items.detail: TextField variant with leading search icon and clear.

items.title: Order card themes and tags
items.detail: Theme variants per OA framework bucket; order tag chip; 72×82 service icon slot.

items.title: Order controls
items.detail: Side-bar order tab (timer + fare), Reject timer ring button, countdown chip, voice toggle.

items.title: Bundle order card
items.detail: Bundle header, stacked order stop cards, '+' connector.

items.title: Celebration / success card
items.detail: Gradient card with illustration, amount and in-card action; success variant with check badge.

items.title: Home modules
items.detail: Map card + layer pill, Today's Earnings bar, performance banner, stories row, offer card, shortcut tile.

items.title: Plan card
items.detail: Tag pill, eyebrow, big value + struck old value, plan type, video icon, View Details; active state.

items.title: Status illustration with badge
items.detail: Circular illustration with red / green / blue badge for blocked, done, pending.

items.title: Snackbar loading variant
items.detail: Dark snackbar with spinner, then success/error.

items.title: Delivery: swipe button colour
items.context: Every delivery step is a full-width swipe (bike-type mode, so swipe per D02). The file colours it by step: blue ARRIVED, black PICKED / DELIVERED, red REACHED. Your D05 says yellow is the primary.

options.label: Yellow for every step
options.detail: Swipe is the primary action, so it follows D05: always yellow.

options.label: Colour by step
options.detail: Keep the file: blue arrive, black picked/delivered, red reached.

options.label: One dark colour for all
options.detail: Black swipe on every step, yellow reserved for buttons.

items.title: Delivery: compulsory photo not taken yet
items.context: The file's rule (CASES OF PHOTO UPLOAD): 'Picked' is never disabled; if the photo is compulsory and missing, swiping opens the camera with a 'Photo is compulsory' sheet, then continues. Your P01 checklist page instead keeps Complete disabled until every task is done.

options.label: Swipe stays enabled, opens camera
options.detail: As the file says: never block the swipe; take the captain straight to the camera.

options.label: Swipe disabled until photo
options.detail: Same as P01: the swipe is greyed until the photo is uploaded.

items.title: Delivery: 'Amount collected' card with no button
items.context: After payment a centred success card shows and auto-advances to the OTP screen. It has no button and no ×, which breaks R11 (every overlay can be dismissed).

options.label: Allowed: auto-advancing success
options.detail: Short success cards that move on by themselves are an exception to R11.

options.label: Add a button
options.detail: Card gets an 'Okay' / 'Enter OTP' button like the Food-ready pop-up.

items.title: Trip map: go to pickup / drop
items.when: Captain is travelling to a pickup or drop point.
items.structure: Header (stage title 'Go to Pickup Zone' / 'Inside the Pickup Zone' / 'Go to drop', call) → [food only: black Order ID band + green estimated-earnings band] → full map (stop pin by service, route, ETA ring, recenter) → floating 'Go to pickup/drop' pill → stop card (pin, name, address) → full-width swipe (ARRIVED / REACHED).
items.notes: Notes: parcel map hides order ID and earnings; food map shows both. Pickup info 'the same way as bike order, only change the icon'.

items.title: Order stage page (Collect / Complete delivery)
items.when: At the pickup or drop: everything needed to finish the stage, and one swipe to confirm.
items.structure: Header (stage title, call) → order ID row → status strips (orange 'requires an OTP', red delay) → status card (yellow 'Please collect payment ₹130' / green 'Amount collected online' / green 'Food is ready') → [earnings + wait timer] → collapsible Pickup and Drop details cards (name, address, Call customer + Go to location, partner chip) → Items card (checkbox, qty, restricted-items consent) → [Drop-off notes] → Upload photo tile ('Compulsory') → sticky swipe (PICKED / DELIVERED).
items.notes: Parcel and food share it. File inconsistencies: food pickup is titled 'Collect Parcel'; two drop screens show different payment status.

items.title: Proof-of-delivery photo
items.when: Package photo at pickup or drop, compulsory or optional per order.
items.structure: Upload tile on the stage page → camera (no frame box) → bottom instruction panel (compulsory: red 'Photo is compulsory for this order') → Retry | Submit → 'Uploading, please wait…' card → back to page with 'Upload successful' snackbar + photo + Delete photo.
items.notes: Same camera → preview → loader as P03/P16 ('use the same loader'). Behaviour when the photo is missing is decision D17.

items.title: OTP entry page
items.when: Handover needs a 4-digit code from the sender or receiver (only on orders that require it).
items.structure: Header (back, 'Complete pickup' / 'Complete delivery', call) → black band: order ID + sender/receiver name → 'Enter pickup/drop OTP' + 4 boxes → helper 'Please ask customer for OTP' → numeric keyboard (✓ submits) → 'Please wait…' card.
items.notes: Title truncates in the file ('Complete package pick…', R02). No resend or on-screen submit.

items.title: Wait timer and food-prep countdown
items.when: Captain waits at the restaurant: show when food is ready and when the wait charge starts.
items.structure: Green earnings header '₹30 + wait charge' → Wait timer mm:ss + info line ('After 4 mins you will get extra waiting charge' → 'You are now earning wait charges') → card 'Please wait! Food will be ready in' + flip-digit countdown → red delay strip when overdue → replaced by green 'Food order is ready!'.

items.title: Collect payment at pickup
items.when: Sender pays at pickup (parcel).
items.structure: Payments header + ? → amount card + yellow 'not your final earning' note → QR (Generate QR → generating → QR) → OR → yellow Collect cash → centred 'Amount collected successfully' card → straight to OTP.
items.notes: Close to P11. The success card is decision D18.

items.title: 'Use Rapido Maps' sheet after pickup
items.when: Pickup is done; offer in-app navigation to the drop.
items.structure: Sheet with green tinted top (illustration, 'Perfect pick-up!') → icon → 'Use Rapido Maps' + body → outline 'No, thanks' + yellow 'Go to maps'.
items.notes: Like P18 (tinted header). Needs the floating × (D09).

items.title: Swipe-to-confirm button
items.detail: Full-width slider with arrow knob and label (ARRIVED, PICKED, REACHED, DELIVERED). Not in Runway; also used by bike/auto/cab trips (D02). Colour is D16.

items.title: OTP input
items.detail: 4 square digit boxes, focused and filled states, helper text.

items.title: Stop details card
items.detail: Collapsible: section title, pin + name + address, yellow Call customer + outline Go to location, optional partner chip.

items.title: Items checklist card
items.detail: Item / quantity rows with checkboxes and a restricted-items consent line.

items.title: Payment status card
items.detail: Yellow 'Please collect payment ₹X' / green 'Amount collected online'.

items.title: Earnings and wait timer card
items.detail: Green earnings band, wait timer states (inactive / active / earning), flip-digit food-prep countdown.

items.title: Order ID band
items.detail: Black band under the header: order ID, plus sender/receiver name on OTP screens.
